space S68: لا برهان عام زائف للاستواء
symbolic vector operations and norms use the actual exact coordinates
two requested geometric operands stay distinct and preserve their parent label
plural normal requests bind each named plane instead of reusing the first
weighted pairs bind weights by point name, reject duplicate points, and detect zero total weight
two/three/four-point barycenters retain actual input vertices and exact weighted residuals
midpoints are derived from declarations, never manufactured from a requested proof
a false basis claim is refuted by rank, not disguised as a scene or an orthonormal basis
dot-product notation is not a cross product and a false perpendicular claim stays visibly false
the perpendicular foot satisfies its plane, normal direction and exact distance
failed geometric parsing cannot leak an earlier height into a numeric follow-up
an independent geometry demand survives an earlier matrix failure with all givens and source label
the line-intersection bridge carries all three equations and its actual t/s solution
every geometry operation has two meaningfully different solved examples
loading a solid example preserves the selected solid and changes its real dimensions
geometric-dot examples preserve radians/grads and their explicit unit beats the global setting
reopening named plane/line/center answers preserves their output aliases as well as input data
all six matrix rows can be reopened as vectors and returned without silent truncation
completed submitted answers contain their final result, steps and actions immediately even with animation enabled
geometry splitting stays bounded and never separates a single algebra/proof expression
coordinate declarations remain geometry, not an overwrite of a previous named matrix
vector/statistical bridges choose a free matrix alias and reuse it instead of erasing given M
real geometry contexts keep valid guards without treating unsupported proof goals as definitions
probability P(A) definitions remain event data even after a geometric A/B context
geometric suggestions stop claiming an unchanged line bridge after an equation is edited
a computed vector r remains explicitly addressable after switching the active vector
